findings.claim: The refusal notice's stated reason is false for the ordinary TW configuration: with FinMind institutional data present (the only TW provider, and it always populates `Panel.institutional`) a 3-name pool CAN produce a gap below the hurdle, so the guard refuses to auto-fill and prints an ALERT while telling the user something the data contradicts — and it refuses pools that R13's own acceptance criterion says should be scored.
findings.evidence: kuroshio/cli.py:279-289 computes `need` from `profile.min_rank_weight`, which tw.py:31-38 fixes at 1/3 — the *institution-degraded* config. When institution is present `weighted_score` (kuroshio/core/screening/score.py:36-44) gives per-pctrank weights (1/6, 1/6, 1/6, 1/2), so the composite's finest step is 1/6/(n-1) = 0.0833 at n=3, not 0.1667. Concrete input: TW pool 1101/1103/1104, monotone close ramps, `institutional` = 3000/1000/2000, all three `degraded=False`; `score_names` returns 1.0 / 0.2917 / 0.2083 → gap 0.0833 < hurdle+friction 0.15585, i.e. the hurdle can reject. Yet kuroshio/cli.py:281-286 prints `every non-tie ordering of that many names clears it by construction (needs 4)` and the run ends in the `No current holding has a screener score` ALERT. Same false universal is asserted as fact in the docstring at kuroshio/cli.py:263-268 and in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:209-214. No eval case covers it: every TW stub panel in tests/test_cli.py is built by `_tw_panel` as `Panel(close=..., volume=...)` with `institutional=None`, so `global_degraded` is True in 100% of the suite and the non-degraded config is never scored.
findings.repro: scratchpad/r18.py and scratchpad/r18cli.py — 3-name TW panel with a populated `institutional` frame. r18.py prints `gaps: [0.0833, 0.7083, 0.7917]` against `hurdle: 0.15585`; r18cli.py runs `propose --market tw` on the same panel and prints the `clears it by construction (needs 4)` notice plus the ALERT.
findings.acceptance: Either the guard accounts for the factors actually present in `ranked` (so a non-degraded TW pool of 3 is scored, matching R13's acceptance wording "pools where the smallest achievable non-zero composite gap is >= turnover.hurdle + friction/100"), or the notice and the docs stop asserting "every non-tie ordering clears it by construction" and state the actual conservative rule (the coarsest degraded composite). Either way, one test with a `Panel` carrying an `institutional` frame pins the chosen behavior, so flipping it goes red.
findings.route_reason: Dishonest claim: the refusal notice and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md assert 'every non-tie ordering clears it by construction' as a universal, and it is false whenever TW institutional data is present (per-rank weights 1/6, step 0.0833 at n=3 vs hurdle 0.15585 — orchestrator-verified). The guard errs safe; only its stated reason is wrong.

findings.claim: The US half of the new guard has no eval case at all — `us.MIN_RANK_WEIGHT` can be set to any value, including 0.0 (guard permanently off, R13's artifact fully re-admitted for `--market us`), and the suite stays green.
findings.evidence: kuroshio/core/screening/us.py:33-38 introduces `MIN_RANK_WEIGHT = min(WEIGHTS["momentum"], WEIGHTS["volume"]) / (WEIGHTS["momentum"] + WEIGHTS["volume"])` = 0.37523 and kuroshio/core/screening/__init__.py:36-37 wires it into the `us` profile, but no test reaches it: every `--market us` propose in the suite (tests/test_discord.py:100/131, tests/test_cli.py:105-221) hand-types `score:`, so `cmd_propose` never calls `_score_missing` and the US `need` is never computed. Mutating the constant to `0.0` gives `need = floor(0.0/0.1502) + 2 = 2`, i.e. no guard for US at any pool size; mutating it to `0.99` gives `need = 8`, refusing pools of 4-7 that the gate can reject. Both leave `pytest tests/ -q` at 129 passed. By contrast the TW value is well pinned — halving, doubling, and `+2 -> +1` / `+2 -> +3` on `need` each go red.
findings.repro: set `MIN_RANK_WEIGHT = 0.0` in kuroshio/core/screening/us.py, then `pytest tests/ -q` -> `129 passed`. Same for `0.99`.
findings.acceptance: One US propose case with a score-less holding and a stub yfinance-shaped panel — a 3-name pool asserting the refusal notice + ALERT and a 4-name pool asserting the SWAP + disclosure, mirroring `test_propose_refuses_when_the_hurdle_cannot_reject_anything` — so setting `us.MIN_RANK_WEIGHT` to 0.0 or 0.99 turns the suite red.
findings.route_reason: Same basis as R11: the REPAIR hard rule requires the fix to be pinned by a gate case, and the US half of the R13 guard is unpinned — us.MIN_RANK_WEIGHT can be set to 0.0, disabling the guard entirely for --market us, with the suite still green.
